correctness.rationale: For n>=4 the wheel metric on rim vertices has distance 1 exactly on adjacent pairs, 2 otherwise, hence induced-cycle graph isomorphisms are the correct maps. Given k<n and r cyclic runs, the count of A of component type m_j is n(r-1)! binom(n-k-1,r-1)/prod m_j!; each ordered pair has prod m_j! times 2^{sum_{j>=2}m_j} isomorphisms. The multinomial generating function x(1+x)/(1-x) gives the claimed rank coefficients. At k=n dihedral maps are 2n, at k=0 one empty map. For s=floor(n/2), s! <=T_n<=4^n 2^s s!+2n yields 1/2 log scale; 2n<=E_n<=2n 2^n then gives -1/2 for the log fraction. Independent type-count calculation matches every rank for n=4..9 and totals 97,286,955,3396,12753,50482; finite checks do not establish the limits.
